scope: New own Windows x64 finite rotation-math platform adapter. Does not replace or relax the old rewards CRT profile, recover CRT internals or validate original-game runtime behavior.

binding_evidence.limitation: API-set import contract is established. The original game's loaded host DLL, state and numerical outputs are not observed.

contract.platform: Windows x64 process and fixed C:\Windows\System32; no alternative source/name/profile fallback
contract.loader: Absolute system path plus LOAD_LIBRARY_SEARCH_SYSTEM32 (0x800); no SetDllDirectory, AddDllDirectory, SetDefaultDllDirectories or security-setting changes
contract.origin: Fixed file hash/version/size, held read-only file handle without write/delete sharing; actual loaded module path and GetProcAddress owner checked. These checks do not establish a memory-image hash of an already loaded same-path UCRT.
contract.signature: [UnmanagedFunctionPointer(Cdecl)] float(float), explicit R4 input/output; _controlfp_s int(out uint,uint,uint). Windows x64 scalar float uses XMM0.
contract.inputs: acosf normal-or-zero finite [-1,1]; cosf/sinf normal-or-zero finite [-4,4] radians. Both signed zeros admitted; subnormals, NaNs, infinities and outside-range values are rejected before math invocation as an own supported-domain boundary.
contract.floating_control: Query _controlfp_s(out word,0,0) only; nearest rounding, all exceptions masked, denormals preserved, no ambiguity. Check before/after each math call; never write control.
contract.outputs: finite normal-or-zero. Returned System.Single bits are consumed directly, never Math(double) substituted.
contract.test_scope: 11 new own scenarios planned, 33 native float calls, independent known acos angles and 20-term sin/cos Taylor reference on |x|<=4, signed-zero observations, failure gates and disposal; no old test suite.

official_sources.supports: float acosf(float), finite inverse-cosine domain and exceptional-input behavior
float cosf(float), radians and nonfinite inputs
float sinf(float), radians and nonfinite inputs
zero mask queries only; mask constants; x64 SSE2/MXCSR control behavior
absolute path, SYSTEM32 dependency search flag, redirection caveat
FROM_ADDRESS ownership and UNCHANGED_REFCOUNT lifetime limitation
prototyped float argument and return in XMM registers
UCRT math is approximate; CPU and runtime versions can change results
